records.detail: The Central Bank of Ireland ran a public tender, reference 2022P012, to appoint an investment manager for its own portfolio of equities, and the Irish contract award notice names UBS Asset Management (UK) Ltd of 5 Broadgate, London as the contractor, for a contract valued at 10 million euro excluding VAT.
records.source_title: Contract award notice: A contract for the provision of equity investment services for the Central Bank of Ireland (ref 2022P012), eTenders / eu-supply Ireland
records.quote: Name and address of the contractor UBS Asset Management (UK) Ltd

records.detail: In an earlier round of the same arrangement, tender reference 2016P038 for Equity Management Services, the Central Bank of Ireland appointed Amundi Asset Management of 90 Boulevard Pasteur, Paris to run its portfolio of equities, for a contract valued at 700,000 euro excluding VAT.
records.source_title: Contract award notice: Equity Management Services, Central Bank of Ireland (ref 2016P038), eTenders / eu-supply Ireland
records.quote: Name and address of the contractor Amundi Asset Management

not_found.note: CBRT Annual Report 2025, section 2.7 International Reserves and Risk Management (www3.tcmb.gov.tr/yillikrapor/2025/en/m-2-7/): says reserves are managed by the CBRT itself under Law No. 1211; no external manager named.
HKMA Annual Report 2025, chapter 17 Reserves Management: confirms external fund managers run about 29% of the Exchange Fund's assets, but names none of them.
Bank of Namibia Annual Report 2025 (BON-ANNUAL-REPORT-30-MARCH.pdf): note 30 shows an 'Externally managed portfolios' line at 37% of the USD portfolio, but no manager is named anywhere in the report.
SARB Annual Report 2025/26 (sarb-2025-26.pdf): states 'External Fund Managers oversee a portion of the' reserves, without naming any firm.
Bank of Ghana Annual Report and Financial Statements 2025: no external, outsourced or appointed reserve manager named; only a BIS collateralised gold transfer appears.

Banco Central do Brasil, Relatorio Anual de Gestao das Reservas Internacionais 2026 (data to Dec 2025): describes the whole reserve portfolio as 'carteira administrada internamente' (internally managed); BIS appears only as a bond issuer.
BCB Informe Semestral RIN 3T-2026: lists UBS AG, JPMorgan Chase, Deutsche Bank, Bank of Montreal and Toronto Dominion only as banks holding gold deposits abroad, which is custody and not management.
CNB quarterly information on international reserves as of 31 December 2025: page gives actively managed portfolio sizes but names no external manager beyond those already on the map.
Heritage and Stabilisation Fund Annual Report 2022 (finance.gov.tt), the fund the Central Bank of Trinidad and Tobago manages: reports external managers' fees and performance but names no manager.
Bank of Botswana Annual Report 2024: names The Northern Trust Company only as global custodian and administrator of its securities lending programme; no further external fund manager named.
Central Bank of Sri Lanka Financial Statements 2025 (32_Financial_Statements.pdf): no external fund manager, mandate or BIS investment pool named in the reserve notes.

Central Bank of Nigeria Reserve Management page (cbn.gov.ng/intops) and CBN Annual Report 2022: both describe the CBN itself as managing Nigeria's external reserves under section 2(c) of the CBN Act 2007; no external manager named.

Central Banking award profile 'Reserve manager: Central Bank of the UAE' (centralbanking.com/awards/7933491): says leading external asset managers were expected to start handling part of the portfolio in 2022, the first time the CBUAE approved outside partners, but names none. centralbank.ae reserve-management page returns 403 to plain curl.
Reserve Bank of Fiji Annual Report August 2023 - July 2024 (tabled in Parliament): no external fund manager, mandate or BIS pool named.
Central Bank of Samoa Annual Report 2023/2024: no external fund manager named.
Maldives Monetary Authority Annual Report 2024: no external fund manager, RAMP membership or BIS pool named.
Central Bank of Montenegro, International Reserves page (cbcg.me): describes the CBCG setting its own benchmarks and running the portfolios itself against ICE indices; no external manager named.
rbm.mw front page document list reachable under plain curl, but it carries no annual report or reserves-management report; no reserve-manager disclosure found.
